name: Ask whether the customer already has a TCR brand elsewhere
description: If yes, they can reference their existing brand ID on the self-service compliance form instead of registering a new one - saves them the brand fee.

name: Point the customer at the self-service registration form
description: /my/sms/compliance - self-service and deliberate: they're the one certifying their own EIN and business details, not you.

name: Confirm real prices are set on the brand/campaign fee products
description: These shipped as $0.00 placeholders - check before this customer's submission if you haven't already set real pricing on any previous one.

name: Confirm the submission actually went through
description: Check the signalwire.brand/signalwire.campaign records show a real state (submitted/pending), not still draft.

name: Wait for carrier approval
description: Typically 3-5 business days. The daily status-poll cron keeps the record's state in sync automatically - no need to check SignalWire's own dashboard by hand.

name: Once approved: enable SMS on the customer's number(s)
description: "Request SMS Enablement" on each signalwire.phone_number ties it to the now-approved campaign - a number isn't SMS-capable just because the campaign is approved, this step still has to happen per number.

name: Send a real test SMS before telling the customer they're live
description: Confirms the number-to-campaign link actually took, not just that the campaign shows approved.
